about_the_game:
Adds the "Ebony Outlaw" costume for Rutger.

Note:
- Costumes are available after unlocking base building and placing a Dressing Room (the relevant characters must also have joined your party).
- This product is part of the "Atelier Yumia Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official "Atelier Yumia" site for details.
